description: Manage this account's watchlists. action=list needs nothing else; other actions need watchlist (name or id). update accepts new filters, alert_preferences or new_name.

include_public_inspection.description: Alert on Public Inspection filings before publication. Default true.

reminder_days.description: Days before deadlines to remind. Default [30,14,7,1].

filters.description: What to watch. All dimensions you set must match; any value within one may match. rins, dockets and document_numbers match on their own.

agencies.description: Agency abbreviations (EPA, SEC, FDA, OSHA, FAA…) or FederalRegister.gov slugs.

cfr.description: CFR titles/parts, e.g. [{title: 48}] for federal acquisition rules.

document_numbers.description: Specific Federal Register documents to follow.

document_types.description: RULE = final rules, PRORULE = proposed rules.

industries.description: Topical industry match via CFR titles and subject keywords (not legal applicability).

keywords.description: Words or phrases matched in title, abstract and action line, e.g. ['cybersecurity', 'incident reporting'].

name: manage_regulatory_watchlist
title: List, update, pause, resume or delete watchlists
